title: Street fence maximum height 900 mm (R100-SL, Table 2.10a)
text: Table 2.10a: C3.6.5 Street fences to not exceed 900mm in height.

replaces.note: Table 2.10a modified provision for lots less than 100 m2

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: Replaces the 1.8 m cap of C3.6.5(i) for R100-SL. Table 2.10a footnote: where development abuts an adjoining property not coded R100-SL the modified provisions do not apply (footnote is attached to 3.4, 3.9 and 3.10 rows, not to 3.6).

verified.note: Table 2.10a row 3.6 Streetscape / C3.6.5: 'Street fences to not exceed 900mm in height.' The footnote marker is on the 3.4, 3.9 and 3.10 rows only.
